prompt.zh-TW: 風行腳踏車行今年的本期淨利是 {{money:vars.profit}}，沒有發放股利。年底結帳之後，這筆利益會留在哪裡？
prompt.en: Breeze Bicycles made a profit of {{money:vars.profit}} this year and paid no dividend. After the year-end close, where does this profit end up?

text.zh-TW: 流進未分配盈餘，仍留在股東權益裡
text.en: Flows into unappropriated retained earnings and stays within equity

feedback.zh-TW: 答對了。賺到而沒分掉的利益，就是股東留在公司裡的錢。
feedback.en: That’s right. Profit that is earned and not paid out is money the owners have left in the company.

text.zh-TW: 隨著年度結束歸零，明年重新開始
text.en: Reset to zero as the year ends, starting afresh next year

short.en: Reset to zero at year end

feedback.zh-TW: 損益表的數字確實每年重新累計，這點沒錯。但利益沒有消失：它搬進了未分配盈餘，留在資產負債表上。
feedback.en: The income statement does start again each year, that much is right. But the profit does not vanish: it moves into unappropriated retained earnings and stays on the balance sheet.

text.zh-TW: 變成資產負債表上同樣金額的現金
text.en: Becomes the same amount of cash on the balance sheet

feedback.zh-TW: 利益留在公司裡，這點你想對了。但利益不是現金：有一部分可能還在應收帳款裡，也可能已經拿去買了車架。
feedback.en: You are right that the profit stays in the company. But profit is not cash: part of it may still be in receivables, or may already have been spent on frames.

explanation.zh-TW: 損益表的本期淨利流進未分配盈餘，留在資產負債表的股東權益裡，所以{{option:o_1jdv}}正確。這是損益表與資產負債表之間的連動；{{option:o_tstc}}以為利益會消失，{{option:o_1dkg}}把利益當成現金。
explanation.en: Profit for the period flows into unappropriated retained earnings and stays in equity on the balance sheet, so {{option:o_1jdv}} is right. This is the link between the income statement and the balance sheet; {{option:o_tstc}} assumes the profit vanishes, and {{option:o_1dkg}} treats profit as cash.
